speculation.hypothesis: Micromax can differentiate as a trustworthy programmable instrument rather than as another feature-maximal terminal editor.
speculation.support: Its strongest existing assets are headless truth, explicit authority, provenance, bounded effects, and recovery.
speculation.falsifier: Dogfood shows that ordinary editing remains too awkward for the trust model to matter or users cannot understand the authority distinctions.

speculation.hypothesis: A small WIT-like public world should precede any Wasm or process-isolated extension host.
speculation.support: Current component-model practice separates imports, exports, worlds, and focused interfaces; Zed compiles extensions to wasm32-wasip2.
speculation.falsifier: A second consumer cannot express required editor behavior without exposing broad mutable Editor internals.

speculation.hypothesis: The current revision ritual is partly compensating for insufficient product feedback.
speculation.support: The repository has deep local proof and repeated optimization notes but little retained sustained-use evidence.
speculation.falsifier: Five sessions reveal no meaningful product friction and show that the existing revision sequence was driven by repeatedly observed user pain.

external_research_retrieved_2026_08_01.observation: The comparison editor presents itself first as modern and intuitive rather than leading with internal architecture.
Built-in help and a direct Ctrl-G help path reinforce the importance of a discoverable ordinary loop.
WIT describes component contracts independently of implementation language.
Worlds define imports and exports, interfaces stay focused, and components interact through declared interfaces rather than shared memory.
A current editor extension system uses a declared extension SDK and compiles Rust extensions to wasm32-wasip2.
Modern editor differentiation can come from coherent semantic interaction rather than only feature count.
Provenance is useful when subjects are retained and consumers verify it; an attestation alone is not a general security guarantee.
User-perceived character boundaries and terminal/display width are distinct concerns; East Asian Width is informative and actual glyph layout remains environment-dependent.
The Micromax name is actively used by an established technology company, creating discoverability and release-identity risk. This is not a legal conclusion.
